From db6aaf4d55f95dcb6b162c3a59b56eb1e85ccdfe Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Russell King <rmk+kernel@arm.linux.org.uk>
Date: Tue, 24 Sep 2013 10:37:13 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i2c: tda998x: fix audio muting

Fix a bug that was introduced in commit c4c11dd160a8 ("drm/i2c: tda998x:
add video and audio input configuration") when Sebastian cleaned up my
original patch.  Without this being fixed, audio is muted when the
display is turned off, never to be re-enabled.

Signed-off-by: Russell King <rmk+kernel@arm.linux.org.uk>
Cc: Sebastian Hesselbarth <sebastian.hesselbarth@gmail.com>
Cc: Darren Etheridge <detheridge@ti.com>
Cc: Dave Airlie <airlied@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i2c/tda998x_drv.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i2c/tda998x_drv.c
index b1f8fc69023f..60e84043aa34 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i2c/tda998x_drv.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i2c/tda998x_drv.c
@@ -707,8 +707,7 @@ tda998x_encoder_dpms(struct drm_encoder *encoder, int mode)
 		reg_write(encoder, REG_VIP_CNTRL_2, priv->vip_cntrl_2);
 		break;
 	case DRM_MODE_DPMS_OFF:
-		/* disable audio and video ports */
-		reg_write(encoder, REG_ENA_AP, 0x00);
+		/* disable video ports */
 		reg_write(encoder, REG_ENA_VP_0, 0x00);
 		reg_write(encoder, REG_ENA_VP_1, 0x00);
 		reg_write(encoder, REG_ENA_VP_2, 0x00);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i2c/tda998x_drv.c`**
   - The code block handling the `DRM_MODE_DPMS_OFF` case has been modified. 
   - The comment and functionality related to disabling audio ports (`reg_write(encoder, REG_ENA_AP, 0x00);`) has been removed.
   - The comment now specifies that only video ports are being disabled, and the corresponding code for disabling audio has been eliminated.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `tda998x_drv.c` addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit that caused audio to remain muted when the display was turned off. By removing the line that disables the audio ports, the patch ensures that audio remains enabled even when the display is turned off, thus fixing the issue of audio muting. This change is directly related to the functionality of the audio and video ports during the power management state transition, specifically when the display is set to the off state.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
-		/* disable audio and video ports */
-		reg_write(encoder, REG_ENA_AP, 0x00);
```
Reason:
The removal of the line that disables the audio ports (`REG_ENA_AP`) when the display is turned off caused the audio to remain muted indefinitely. This oversight meant that during the DPMS state transition, the audio control was not properly managed, leading to the audio being muted when the display was powered down.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+		/* disable video ports */
```
Reason:
By reintroducing the management of audio ports during the DPMS transition, the patch ensures that the audio is properly disabled when the display is turned off, allowing it to be re-enabled when the display is powered back on. This change restores the intended functionality of the audio control in relation to the display state.
